verdict.rationale: Rainforest's own docs state that platforms keep full ownership of all payment and merchant data and may export it at any time, which directly addresses the portability and leaving part of the story. The evidence never names an export mechanism or any file format, so 'open formats' is unproven. The claim also sits on an unrelated JavaScript bundle page, with no dedicated export guide and no independent confirmation. Missing for 10: documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), a described bulk-export or offboarding mechanism, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Platforms using Rainforest retain full ownership of all payment and merchant data and may export it at any time.
